shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated ornament running along the top edge
row/register organisation of figures along a horizontal axis
repeated identical motifs in a frieze
justification: Both surfaces use shallow relief organised into horizontal registers, with a band of small repeated motifs running along the upper edge above a frieze of profile figures, which is the most specific shared compositional device. The manner of carving is quite different, however: A is smoothly modelled, precisely detailed and rhythmically spaced on a flat dressed panel, while B is blocky, schematic and irregularly placed on a rough, curving pillar, and A's subject matter (human procession with a laden camel) has no counterpart in B's animal and bird imagery.
